title: Hospital bed at order-sign
demonstrates: A complete CRD order-sign request: a DeviceRequest for a hospital bed with patient, encounter and coverage prefetch. The payer-B variant shows the same request with coverageBundle and deviceRequestBundle keys.

expected.payerA: Coverage information in systemActions: covered, prior authorization required.
expected.payerB: Coverage information for E0250 inside a card suggestion rather than systemActions; send the payer-B variant so its prefetch keys are satisfied.
